name: mantle-chat
description: Find information in Mantle Chat, organize folders and chats, save writing to new canvases, and ask your saved agents for help.

interface.longDescription:
Find work in Mantle Chat and keep it organized from your AI assistant. Browse workspaces, folders, chats, channels, canvases, saved agents, and tasks. Read recent messages and canvas documents when your account has permission.

Create folders, rename items, and move them into folders. Save meeting notes or a project brief in a new canvas, which is a document in Mantle. Post plain-text updates to channels you choose; messages are sent as your signed-in Mantle user. Sending messages into individual chats is not supported.

Ask a saved Mantle agent for help or prepare changes to an agent draft. Agent calls are available only in selected workspaces. Your specific request is sent to the agent's configured model provider, which may be a third party. Its configured tools may also read or change connected services, such as updating documents or posting messages, subject to Mantle's tool permissions. Background changes require prior approval for that specific tool; other writes are blocked. Mantle encrypts agent-call prompts and answers, makes their content expire after 24 hours, and schedules run details for cleanup after 30 days. Your assistant and model providers have their own retention policies.

Sign in with your Mantle account. Never paste passwords or API keys into a conversation. Mantle checks your access for each action. Review the exact item, message, or workspace settings before approving changes in your assistant.

The plugin cannot rewrite an existing canvas document, manage billing or members, delete an entire workspace, or start scheduled tasks.
defaultPrompt: Find my work in Mantle Chat.
Summarize this conversation and save it in a new Mantle canvas.
Ask my saved Mantle agent for help.
